global_rules: Answer ONLY from this KB. If a fact is not here, say it is not in the playbook and to confirm with Brett — never invent.
RaptorTech scope only. Do not describe capabilities, integrations, certifications, or products not stated here.

NO superlative or comparative claims about RaptorTech. Do not generate 'best', 'world-first', 'most advanced', 'market-leading', 'industry benchmark', or similar. State capabilities and specifications factually and let them speak.

Safety systems are ASSISTIVE ONLY (clause 28). Never describe CAS, fatigue, proximity, or guidance as autonomous control, as guaranteeing incident prevention, or as replacing operational procedures or statutory obligations.
Items tagged status 'certification_pending' or 'roadmap_future' are NOT available now. Never present them as shipping or available.
Items tagged 'confirm_signed' (SLA terms, fees, rosters, credits) vary per signed agreement. Always say to confirm against the specific customer's signed contract.
Example studies are anonymised method references only. Never quote their specific figures as RaptorTech benchmarks, and never name the client or any individual.
All AI output is an internal draft for human review before any client use.

PrecisN.name: PrecisN (Machine Guidance / HPGPS)
PrecisN.summary: 3D spatial guidance for operators with execute-to-design accuracy. Operates standalone or integrated.
capabilities: Execute to design to within 20mm
Supports excavators, dozers, graders, loaders, drills and light vehicles
Real-time surface updates visualising progress to plan
Real-time compliance reporting
Upload/sync designs from Raptor Cloud GIS to machines (local upload available)
Height/Depth/Slew restrictions to 3D designs

PerceptN.name: PerceptN (Collision Avoidance)
PerceptN.safety_disclaimer: Assistive only (clause 28). Provides awareness and advisory by default. Does not autonomously control machines unless the optional intervention layer is fitted, and even then operators remain responsible and it does not guarantee incident prevention.
PerceptN.summary: On-machine collision avoidance built from layered detection. Entry-level GPS peer-to-peer avoidance is included in the RaptorOS infrastructure deployment; further layers are added to match risk.
PerceptN.design_provenance: The detection layers use the same categories of perception technology found on autonomous mining equipment, brought down to manned operations. Use this as the autonomous-first narrative — NOT as a claim that the product is autonomous.

PerceptGNSS.label: V2X Precision GPS
PerceptGNSS.detail: RTK GPS ~20mm position accuracy, ~0.3deg heading. V2X vehicle-to-anything up to ~1km tracking range. 5Hz update. Parallel collision algorithms. Includes basic UWB ranging. Forms the core module.
PerceptGNSS.effective_range: up to 500 m (detection via database reference)

PerceptULTRA.label: V2X Ultra-Wideband
PerceptULTRA.detail: UWB ranging and heading; detects threat position with no GPS — suited to underground / GNSS-denied. ~150mm position accuracy, ~5deg heading, 10Hz. Ultra-low-power option suitable for personnel tags.

PerceptVISION.label: AI Machine Vision (camera + radar)
PerceptVISION.detail: Stereo camera depth map to ~40m plus 4D radar to ~120m, onboard NVIDIA GPU, AI object detection/classification at 20Hz, all-weather radar, self-cleaning lens.
PerceptVISION.effective_range: camera 40-60 m, radar up to 120 m
PerceptVISION.availability_note: Certification pending at present. Do not present as available now.

PerceptAUTO.label: Emergency stop / intervention (Level 9)
PerceptAUTO.detail: Robotic intervention control for emergency braking on tracked/wheel equipment. Fail-safe design, dual processors, ~1 hour install with no permanent machine modification. SIL 2 design principles. ISO21815 compatibility undergoing certification.
PerceptAUTO.availability_note: Certification pending at present. The optional Level 9 intervention upgrade is not generally available yet — do not present as shipping. Standard PerceptN provides Level 7 (awareness) and Level 8 (advisory).

emesrt_levels.source: EMESRT — industry body on vehicle interactions in mining; 9 levels of control.
emesrt_levels.percept_coverage: PerceptN provides on-machine Levels 7, 8 and 9 capability. Standard PerceptN delivers Level 7 (Operator Awareness) and Level 8 (Advisory Controls). Level 9 (Intervention Controls) is the optional PerceptAuto upgrade — see its certification_pending status.

levels.7: Operator Awareness — gives operators awareness of nearby vehicles; no advice or intervention
levels.8: Advisory Controls — alerts/alarms advising operator action (e.g. brake for vehicle behind)
levels.9: Intervention Controls — takes direct control of braking to implement a safety stop

4A_CPI.summary: Annual adjustment = greater of 3% p.a. or actual Australian CPI (All Groups, ABS). 30 days notice before review date; auto-applies; customer has 14 days to object in writing (payment not suspended).

4.10_idle_asset.name: Idle asset billing
4.10_idle_asset.summary: Machines recording >10 operating hours/month = full fee; ≤10 hours/month = 30% standby. Applies fleet-wide at all times including during a pause. RaptorTech system data deemed accurate unless materially incorrect.
4.10_idle_asset.framing: Position as a customer benefit — protects them during low-activity periods.

10A_expansions.name: Expansions & reductions
10A_expansions.summary: Expansion ≤15% of subscribed units = portal/email, auto-accepted, billing adjusts next month. >15% = written variation within 5 business days. Each expansion order has its own 18-month minimum. Scope reductions ≤10% in writing with no penalty; max 25% reduction in any rolling 12 months.

16A_renewal.name: Renewal
16A_renewal.summary: Auto-renews annually unless 90+ days written notice. If notice missed, rolls monthly until terminated on 90 days notice.

16B_pause.name: Pause
16B_pause.summary: Qualifying event = customer loses a mining services contract through no fault of their own. Written notice + evidence within 14 days. Max 6 months, once per site per term, term keeps running. Billing during pause governed by clause 4.10 idle rate. Use as a retention/selling lever for contractors.

baseline_study.core_narrative: Top-quartile performance and safety come from holistically solving root causes across Product, Process and People — technology alone does not fix behavioural, design or process issues. This is RaptorTech's central thesis and should anchor baseline-study and CAS conversations.

security.summary: RaptorOS is an IoT platform for mobile mining equipment telemetry, designed for data protection compliance including GDPR alignment.
security.tenancy_isolation: Each customer is a fully isolated tenancy — dedicated VM cluster, dedicated PostgreSQL, MQTT broker and microservices, dedicated NGINX ingress/bastion. No shared databases, brokers, queues or app containers between customers.
security.network_model: Three-zone segmentation: Field Zone (devices, outbound-only MQTT/SFTP, no inbound reachability), Ingress Zone (single externally exposed NGINX bastion — TLS termination, auth, rate-limiting, API firewalling), Application Zone (internal VMs/containers, no external exposure, reachable only via ingress or VPN).
security.transport_security: TLS 1.2+ for HTTP/MQTT, SSH key-based auth for SFTP, no plaintext protocols. Per-tenant domains and TLS certificates prevent misrouting. CBOR-encoded payloads, optional AES-256.
security.identity_access: User apps authenticate via Microsoft/Azure AD with RBAC. Admin access requires VPN + per-user SSH keys + MFA, no shared accounts. Microservices use scoped tokens; least-privilege between services; no shared secrets across tenants. No direct database access for users or client systems.
security.field_device_security: Outbound-only; no externally reachable services. Per-device credentials and strict topic-level ACLs (a device may publish only to its own telemetry topics). Offline store-and-forward with timestamped/signed packets. OTA updates via authenticated channel with signature validation.
security.privacy_by_design: Pseudonymisation via the Raptor Data Number (RDN) model — operator names and direct identifiers are never transmitted in device payloads; human-readable context resolves only in the backend via a controlled master-data dictionary. Operator references can be deleted by administrators, breaking the link to an individual while retaining pseudonymised operational data.
security.gdpr_roles: Customer (mining operator) is Data Controller. RaptorTech is Data Processor when hosted/managed, acting on documented customer instructions under a Data Processing Agreement. For self-hosted deployments the customer defines controller/processor relationships.
security.deployment_options: Cloud or on-premise (Proxmox VE 8.x or VMware ESXi 8.x), identical logical components, no reliance on proprietary managed services.
security.logging: OS, application, security-event and data-access logs to a central collector; retention configurable per customer / regulatory requirement.
security.rule: State these as the platform's security design. Do not claim specific certifications (e.g. ISO 27001) as achieved — the document references compliance alignment, not certification. If asked whether certified, say it is designed to support those obligations and to confirm certification status with RaptorTech.
